summary_brief: 2026年3月17日标志着AI模型能力的重大飞跃：Claude 4.6发布1M上下文窗口和128k输出上限，OpenAI推出GPT-5.3/5.4系列，共同推动大语言模型进入百万token时代。跨平台AI代理系统快速发展，安全架构（沙箱隔离、加密验证、智能审批）和多模态能力成为核心焦点。多家厂商统一推出thinking-display-setting支持，AI推理透明度成为行业标准。

engineering_signals.title: Claude 4.6 发布 1M 上下文窗口与 128k 输出上限，重新定义长上下文标准
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Claude Opus 4.6 和 Sonnet 4.6 将上下文窗口扩展至100万token，输出上限提升至128k（默认64k），这对长文档处理、大规模代码生成和多轮对话场景具有革命性意义。同时LiteLLM等工具修复了长上下文配置被默认值覆盖的bug，确保1M上下文能够正确生效。

engineering_signals.title: OpenAI 发布 GPT-5.3/5.4 系列模型，引入 Codex 变体和视频批处理能力
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: GPT-5.3和5.4系列（包括nano/mini变体和codex代码专用版本）的发布标志着新一代大语言模型正式落地，配合/v1/videos批处理端点和defer_loading异步工具调用，为多模态AI应用奠定基础。

engineering_signals.title: Anthropic 全平台统一推出 thinking-display-setting GA 支持，AI推理透明度成为行业标准
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Python、TypeScript、Go、Java四大官方SDK同时GA thinking-display-setting，配合gptme等项目统一不同LLM提供商的推理内容输出格式（将<thinking>标签转换为可折叠thinking blocks），使AI推理过程可视化成为跨平台标配能力。

engineering_signals.title: AI 代理安全架构全面升级：沙箱隔离、加密验证与智能审批成为标配
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: 多个项目同步强化安全能力：Gemini CLI实现子代理工具隔离和扩展加密完整性验证，OpenAI Codex新增Smart Approvals智能审批和Windows沙箱IPC，Zed添加Shell命令注入防护，gVisor原生沙箱默认启用，共同构建生产级AI代理安全体系。

engineering_signals.title: Claude Agent SDK 补齐核心能力：Skills、Memory、MCP Servers 全面支持
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Python SDK新增skills、memory、mcpServers配置字段，结合每轮对话usage追踪和环境变量default-if-absent语义，使开发者能够通过SDK完整构建具备持久记忆、外部技能调用和MCP集成的复杂多智能体系统。

engineering_signals.title: 分布式 AI 代理系统架构演进：共识协议、异步子代理与客户端-服务器分离
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Claude Flow实现BFT共识和Raft领导选举，DeepAgents支持异步子代理中间件和远程LangGraph服务器执行，CLI客户端-服务器架构解耦UI与运行时，这些进展共同指向可扩展、可容错的分布式AI代理系统方向。

engineering_signals.title: LLM 思考块标记碎片化：Gemini、Claude、DeepSeek 存在格式差异需兼容处理
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Gemini使用</thinking>而非```结束思考块，部分模型（如GPT-5.4）同时通过reasoning.delta SSE事件和<thinking>标签双重输出推理内容，开发者需要针对不同提供商实现去重和兼容逻辑，否则会导致解析失败和eval准确性下降。

engineering_signals.title: 企业级 AI 部署能力增强：预算控制修复、WebSocket 持久化、向量数据库集成

engineering_signals.title: AI 模型生态快速迭代：多个主流模型被弃用，新模型元数据自动匹配成为刚需

releases.summary:
## What's changed

- Increased default maximum output token limits for Claude Opus 4.6 to 64k tokens, and the upper bound for Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6 models to 128k tokens
- Added `allowRead` sandbox filesystem setting to re-allow read access within `denyRead` regions
- `/copy` now accepts an optional index: `/copy N` copies the Nth-latest assistant response
- Fixed "Always Allow" on compound bash commands (e.g. `cd src && npm test`) saving a single rule for the full string instead of per-subcommand, leading to dead rules and repeated permission prompts
- Fixed auto-updater starting overlapping binary downloads when the slash-command overlay repeatedly opened and closed, accumulating tens of gigabytes of memory
- Fixed `--resume` silently truncating recent conversation history due to a race between memory-extraction writes and the main transcript
- Fixed PreToolUse hooks returning `"allow"` bypassing `deny` permission rules, including enterprise managed settings
- Fixed Write tool silently converting line endings when overwriting CRLF files or creating files in CRLF directories
- Fixed memory growth in long-running sessions from progress messages surviving compaction
- Fixed cost and token usage not being tracked when the API falls back to non-streaming mode
- Fixed `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_EXPERIMENTAL_BETAS` not stripping beta tool-schema fields, causing proxy gateways to reject requests
- Fixed Bash tool reporting errors for successful commands when the system temp directory path contains spaces
- Fixed paste being lost when typing immediately after pasting
- Fixed Ctrl+D in `/feedback` text input deleting forward instead of the second press exiting the session
- Fixed API error when dragging a 0-byte image file into the prompt
- Fixed Claude Desktop sessions incorrectly using the terminal CLI's configured API key instead of OAuth
- Fixed `git-subdir` plugins at different subdirectories of the same monorepo commit colliding in the plugin cache
- Fixed ordered list numbers not rendering in terminal UI
- Fixed a race condition where stale-worktree cleanup could delete an agent worktree just resumed from a previous crash
- Fixed input deadlock when opening `/mcp` or similar dialogs while the agent is running
- Fixed Backspace and Delete keys not working in vim NORMAL mode
- Fixed status line not updating when vim mode is toggled on or off
- Fixed hyperlinks opening twice on Cmd+click in VS Code, Cursor, and other xterm.js-based terminals
- Fixed background colors rendering as terminal-default inside tmux with default configuration
- Fixed iTerm2 session crash when selecting text inside tmux over SSH
- Fixed clipboard copy silently failing in tmux sessions; copy toast now indicates whether to paste with `⌘V` or tmux `prefix+]`
- Fixed `←`/`→` accidentally switching tabs in settings, permissions, and sandbox dialogs while navigating lists
- Fixed IDE integration not auto-connecting when Claude Code is launched inside tmux or screen
- Fixed CJK characters visually bleeding into adjacent UI elements when clipped at the right edge
- Fixed teammate panes not closing when the leader exits
- Fixed iTerm2 auto mode not detecting iTerm2 for native split-pane teammates
- Faster startup on macOS (~60ms) by reading keychain credentials in parallel with module loading
- Faster `--resume` on fork-heavy and very large sessions — up to 45% faster loading and ~100-150MB less peak memory
- Improved Esc to abort in-flight non-streaming API requests
- Improved `claude plugin validate` to check skill, agent, and command frontmatter plus `hooks/hooks.json`, catching YAML parse errors and schema violations
- Background bash tasks are now killed if output exceeds 5GB, preventing runaway processes from filling disk
- Sessions are now auto-named from plan content when you accept a plan
- Improved headless mode plugin installation to compose correctly with `CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_SEED_DIR`
- Show a notice when `apiKeyHelper` takes longer than 10s, preventing it from blocking the main loop
- The Agent tool no longer accepts a `resume` parameter — use `SendMessage({to: agentId})` to continue a previously spawned agent
- `SendMessage` now auto-resumes stopped agents in the background instead of returning an error
- Renamed `/fork` to `/branch` (`/fork` still works as an alias)
- [VSCode] Improved plan preview tab titles to use the plan's heading instead of "Claude's Plan"
- [VSCode] When option+click doesn't trigger native selection on macOS, the footer now points to the `macOptionClickForcesSelection` setting

key_changes: 提升 Claude Opus 4.6 和 Sonnet 4.6 模型的输出 Token 上限至 64k/128k
新增 allowRead 沙箱文件系统设置，支持在 denyRead 区域内重新允许读访问
修复 Always Allow 在复合 Bash 命令中的权限规则保存问题，避免重复权限提示
修复自动更新器内存泄漏问题（重复下载累积数十 GB）
修复多个安全与稳定性问题：hook 权限绕过、内存增长、Token 统计丢失等
ai_summary.summary_cn: 此版本主要是一次重要的修复更新，显著提升了 Opus 4.6 和 Sonnet 4.6 模型的输出 Token 上限（最高可达 128k），并新增了 allowRead 沙箱设置功能。同时修复了 15+ 个问题，包括权限管理、内存泄漏、API 回退模式下的统计缺失等关键 Bug，显著提升了稳定性和安全性。

releases.author: QuantumGhost
releases.summary:
## 🚀 Major Functional Changes

### Data platform and dataset operations

- Added **Hologres** as a supported backend option for both vector retrieval and full-text search.
- Added Service API endpoints for dataset document downloads:
  - Batch ZIP download for selected documents.
  - Signed URL download for single-document original files.

### Workflow and chat experience improvements

- **Breaking change:** HITL email content now uses markdown rendering before delivery. 
  Existing email templates that relied on raw/plain behavior may render differently after upgrade.
- Draft variables are now user-scoped instead of app-scoped. Historical draft variables will not be available after upgrading.
- Added edge context menu support in workflow canvas, including direct edge deletion.
- Preserved existing connections when changing node types in workflow editing.
- Added configurable send-key behavior (`Enter` vs `Shift+Enter`) for embedded chat input.
- Added file payloads in message-end stream responses.
- Removed GPT-4-specific hardcoded behavior from default model selection logic.
- Added a new `export-app-messages` CLI command to export application messages and related feedback to `JSONL.GZ` (local or cloud storage).

## 🔐 Security Updates

- Prevented SQL injection risks in vector-store query paths by switching to parameterized SQL in affected implementations.
- Hardened HITL email delivery:
  - Sanitize subject and body content.
  - Strip CR/LF from subjects to prevent SMTP header-injection vectors.
- Enforced ownership checks for conversation deletion APIs.
- Cleared stale provider credentials during plugin uninstall to reduce residual credential risk.
- Improved enterprise API error handling and license-enforcement behavior for invalid/expired license states.

## 🏗️ Configuration, Architecture, and Deployment Updates

### Deployment and operations
- Added a dedicated Celery queue: `dataset_summary` for LLM-heavy summary generation tasks.
  - Ensure workers subscribe to this queue to avoid summary-job backlog.
- Added telemetry metrics for retention cleanup tasks (messages/workflow runs), plus flush behavior for short-lived command jobs.

### Configuration changes

- Added `REDIS_MAX_CONNECTIONS`.
- Deprecated `PUBSUB_*` event-bus settings in favor of `EVENT_BUS_*` settings.

## 🛠 Other Noteworthy Changes

- Fixed `workflow_runs.started_at` being overwritten on resume.
- Fixed metadata batch-edit silent failures caused by split-transaction edge cases.
- Fixed metadata filter extraction issues in knowledge retrieval (`{{...}}` conditions).
- Restored citation visibility in advanced chat applications.
- Fixed conversation variable reset behavior after HITL nodes.
- Fixed a page crash in knowledge-retrieval node configuration flow.
- Fixed chat assistant blocking response-mode behavior.
- Added `doc_type` handling in Weaviate vector attributes for better compatibility.
- Upgraded OpenTelemetry dependencies to resolve context-detach errors.

---

## Upgrade Guide

> [!IMPORTANT]
> If you use custom `CELERY_QUEUES`, make sure `workflow_based_app_execution` is included.  
> If `ENABLE_API_TOKEN_LAST_USED_UPDATE_TASK=true`, also include `api_token`.
> 
> For background and details, see **⚠️ Important Upgrade Note** and **🔧 Operational Note** above.

### Docker Compose Deployments

1. Back up your customized docker-compose YAML file (optional)

   ```bash
   cd docker
   cp docker-compose.yaml docker-compose.yaml.$(date +%s).bak
   ```

2. Get the latest code from the main branch

   ```bash
   git checkout main
   git pull origin main
   ```

3. Stop the service. Please execute in the docker directory

   ```bash
   docker compose down
   ```

4. Back up data

   ```bash
   tar -cvf volumes-$(date +%s).tgz volumes
   ```

5. Upgrade services

   ```bash
   docker compose up -d
   ```

> [!NOTE]
> 
> If you encounter errors like below
> 
> ```bash
> 2025/11/26 11:37:57 /app/internal/db/pg/pg.go:30
> [error] failed to initialize database, got error failed to connect to `host=db_postgres user=postgres database=dify_plugin`: hostname resolving error (lookup db_postgres on 127.0.0.11:53: server misbehaving)
> 
> 2025/11/26 11:37:57 /app/internal/db/pg/pg.go:34
> [error] failed to initialize database, got error failed to connect to `host=db_postgres user=postgres database=postgres`: hostname > resolving error (lookup db_postgres on 127.0.0.11:53: server misbehaving)
> 2025/11/26 11:37:57 init.go:99: [PANIC]failed to init dify plugin db: failed to connect to `host=db_postgres user=postgres database=postgres`: hostname resolving error (lookup db_postgres on 127.0.0.11:53: server misbehaving)
> panic: [PANIC]failed to init dify plugin db: failed to connect to `host=db_postgres user=postgres database=postgres`: hostname resolving error (lookup db_postgres on 127.0.0.11:53: server misbehaving)
> ```
> Please use the following command instead. For details, please read this https://github.com/langgenius/dify/issues/28706
>    ```bash
>    docker compose --profile postgresql up -d
>    ```

### Source Code Deployments

1. Stop the API server, Worker, and Web frontend Server.

2. Get the latest code from the release branch:

   ```bash
   git checkout 1.13.1
   ```

3. Update Python dependencies:

   ```bash
   cd api
   uv sync
   ```

4. Then, let's run the migration script:

   ```bash
   uv run flask db upgrade
   ```

5. Finally, run the API server, Worker, and Web frontend Server again.

---

## What's Changed

key_changes: 新增 Hologres 向量检索和全文搜索支持，以及数据集文档批量下载 API
HITL 邮件内容改为 Markdown 渲染，现有邮件模板可能显示异常（Breaking Change）
草稿变量从应用级改为用户级，升级后历史草稿变量将不可用
修复向量存储 SQL 注入风险，加固 HITL 邮件安全（防 SMTP 头注入）
工作流画布新增边右键菜单、节点类型切换时保留连接、可配置发送键行为
ai_summary.summary_cn: Dify 1.13.1 版本包含两个破坏性变更：HITL 邮件内容改用 Markdown 渲染，以及草稿变量从应用级改为用户级，升级后历史数据将受影响。同时新增了 Hologres 数据源支持、数据集文档下载 API、工作流画布增强功能，并修复了多项安全漏洞包括 SQL 注入风险。

releases.summary:
# Changelog

## New Features:

- **Parallel Search Tool:** Add Parallel AI Search support for Vertex AI with native ToolParallelAiSearch integration
- **Observability:** Extended support with MLflow to have full traces observability of your agents. See [docs](https://docs.agno.com/observability/mlflow#mlflow).
- **Docling Reader:** Integrated [Docling](https://github.com/docling-project/docling) library as a new reader, enabling document processing across a multiple range of file formats.
- **WhatsApp Interface V2:**
    - Added media support (images, video, audio, documents), interactive messages (reply buttons, list menus, locations, reactions), and Team/Workflow support.
    - Users can send `/new` to start fresh conversations.
    - Added `enable_encryption` parameter for encrypting phone numbers
- **Telegram Interface:**
    - Added new Telegram interfaces for AgentOS  with support for agents, teams, and workflows.
    - Multi-modal support and use `/new` to start fresh conversations.
- **Telegram Tools:** Added new tools so agents can send photos, documents, videos, audio, animations, stickers among other things

## Improvements:

- **Workflow:**
    - Added `version` query param to `GET /workflows/{id}`to fetch specific workflow versions.
    - Added run level params like- `metadata`, `dependencies`, `add_dependencies_to_context`, `add_session_state_to_context` similar to agent/team.
- **Mistral:** Added `mistralai` v2 support while maintaining backward compatibility with v1.
- **Gemini:** Added timeout parameter to Gemini model class.

## Bug Fixes:

- `MCPTools`: Fixed race condition where parallel MCP tool calls with `header_provider` would each create duplicate sessions, causing the agent to get stuck.
- **Claude**: Fixed structured output detection for supported models
- **Streaming Tool Calls:** Fixed duplicate tool execution in streaming mode caused by shared dict references in `parse_tool_calls`
- **MongoDb:** Fixed the incorrect import of the pymongo async modules.

## What's Changed
* fix: prevent deadlock in parallel MCP tool calls with header_provider (fixes #6094) by @giulio-leone in https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/6821
* fix: remove unnecessary fast-path stale session cleanup in MCPTools by @ysolanky in https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/6949
* feat: add Parallel web search grounding for Vertex AI Gemini by @ysolanky in https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/6060
* fix: correct async MongoDB import by @v-vinson in https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/6399
* fix: mongo validation by @kausmeows in https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/6957
* feat: add version query param to GET /workflows/{id} endpoint by @harshsinha03 in https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/6956
* fix: async PostgresDb returns None for missing tables instead of logging ERROR by @kausmeows in https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/6965
* [fix] replace fragile blocklist with prefix-based structured output detection by @hztBUAA in https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/6643
* cookbook: add MLflow observability integration via OpenInference by @ysolanky in https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/6930
* chore: add PR triage automation and improve contribution guidelines by @ysolanky in https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/6959

releases.summary:
### Added

- Added W&B Inference by CoreWeave as a new API provider with 17 models
- Improved parallel tool calling support for OpenRouter and Cline providers

### Fixed

- Claude Code Provider: handle rate limit events, empty content arrays, error results, and unknown content types without crashing
- Tool handlers (`read_file`, `list_files`, `list_code_definition_names`, `search_files`) now return graceful errors instead of crashing

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/cline/cline/compare/v2.7.1-cli...v3.73.0

增强 OpenRouter 和 Cline 提供商的并行工具调用支持
修复 Claude Code Provider 对速率限制、空内容数组和错误的处理
改进多个工具处理器（read_file、list_files 等）的错误处理机制
ai_summary.summary_cn: 本次更新新增了 W&B Inference by CoreWeave 作为新的 API 提供商，提供 17 个模型支持，同时增强了 OpenRouter 和 Cline 提供商的并行工具调用能力。在稳定性方面，修复了 Claude Code Provider 对各类异常情况的处理，并改进了多个文件操作工具的错误处理机制，避免程序崩溃。

releases.summary:
## Changes

### PR [#2056](https://github.com/danielmiessler/Fabric/pull/2056) by [mikaelpr](https://github.com/mikaelpr) and [ksylvan](https://github.com/ksylvan): feat: add Codex vendor with OpenAI OAuth

- Add new Codex AI vendor plugin with OpenAI OAuth PKCE flow
- Implement browser-based login with automatic token refresh on 401
- Allow explicit Codex model selection bypassing model listing
- Expose shared OpenAI `BuildResponseParams` and `ExtractText` helpers, and move system/developer messages into Codex `instructions` field
- Add comprehensive unit tests for Codex OAuth, streaming, and retry
- New internationalization keys added for all 11 languages.

key_changes: 新增 Codex AI 供应商插件，支持 OpenAI OAuth PKCE 认证流程
实现基于浏览器的登录机制，并在 401 错误时自动刷新令牌
支持显式指定 Codex 模型，绕过模型列表查询
新增覆盖 OAuth、流式处理和重试逻辑的完整单元测试
为全部 11 种语言新增国际化翻译键
ai_summary.summary_cn: 本次发布新增了 Codex AI 供应商插件，集成了 OpenAI OAuth PKCE 认证流程，支持浏览器登录和自动令牌刷新。同时优化了模型选择机制，允许显式指定 Codex 模型，并为所有 11 种语言添加了相应的国际化支持。

releases.summary:
## New Features
- Supported models can now request full-resolution image inspection through both `view_image` and `codex.emitImage(..., detail: "original")`, which helps with precision visual tasks. (#14175)
- `js_repl` now exposes `codex.cwd` and `codex.homeDir`, and saved `codex.tool(...)` / `codex.emitImage(...)` references keep working across cells. (#14385, #14503)
- Realtime websocket sessions gained a dedicated transcription mode, plus v2 handoff support through the `codex` tool, with a unified `[realtime]` session config. (#14554, #14556, #14606)
- The v2 app-server now exposes filesystem RPCs for file reads, writes, copies, directory operations, and path watching, and there is a new Python SDK for integrating with that API. (#14245, #14435)
- Smart Approvals can now route review requests through a guardian subagent in core, app-server, and TUI, reducing repeated setup work on follow-up approvals. (#13860, #14668)
- App integrations now use the Responses API tool-search flow, can suggest missing tools, and fall back cleanly when the active model does not support search-based lookup. (#14274, #14287, #14732)

## Bug Fixes
- Spawned subagents now inherit sandbox and network rules more reliably, including project-profile layering, persisted host approvals, and symlinked writable roots. (#14619, #14650, #14674, #14807)
- `js_repl` no longer hangs when dynamic tool responses contain literal U+2028 or U+2029 characters. (#14421)
- The TUI no longer stalls on exit after creating subagents, and interrupting a turn no longer tears down background terminals by default. (#14816, #14602)
- `codex exec --profile` once again preserves profile-scoped settings when starting or resuming a thread. (#14524)
- MCP and elicitation flows are more robust, with safer tool-name normalization and preserved `tool_params` in approval prompts. (#14491, #14605, #14769)
- The local network proxy now serves CONNECT traffic as explicit HTTP/1, improving compatibility with HTTP proxy clients. (#14395)

## Chores
- The subagent wait tool is now consistently named `wait_agent`, aligning it with `spawn_agent` and `send_input`. (#14631)

## Changelog

Full Changelog: https://github.com/openai/codex/compare/rust-v0.114.0...rust-v0.115.0

- #14395 fix(network-proxy): serve HTTP proxy listener as HTTP/1 @viyatb-oai
- #14385 Add js_repl cwd and homeDir helpers @fjord-oai
- #14376 Keep agent-switch word-motion keys out of draft editing @joshka-oai
- #14175 Let models opt into original image detail @fjord-oai
- #14382 check for large binaries in CI @owenlin0
- #14392 chore(app-server): stop emitting codex/event/ notifications @owenlin0
- #14274 feat: search_tool migrate to bring you own tool of Responses API @apanasenko-oai
- #14174 refactor: centralize filesystem permissions precedence @viyatb-oai
- #14394 chore(app-server): delete unused rpc methods from v1.rs @owenlin0
- #14171 fix: align core approvals with split sandbox policies @viyatb-oai
- #14410 Make collab model metadata accurate on completion @aibrahim-oai
- #14387 feat(app-server): propagate traces across tasks and core ops @owenlin0
- #14407 chore: use AVAILABLE and ON_INSTALL as default plugin install and auth policies @sayan-oai
- #14287 [apps] Add tool_suggest tool. @mzeng-openai

releases.summary:
### Highlights

* **Client-server architecture:** The CLI can now connect to a remote agent backend via `langgraph dev`, decoupling the UI from the runtime and unlocking server-side execution workflows.
* **Expanded model ecosystem:** Added LiteLLM and Baseten as built-in providers. The `/model` selector now shows live model status, supports an `enabled` flag to hide providers, and auto-discovers models for `class_path` (arbitrary) providers.
* **CLI ergonomics:** New `-y` and `-S` short flags for `--auto-approve` and `--shell-allow-list`. The `ask_user` tool is now enabled by default, and the welcome banner rotates helpful tips.
* **Performance:** Integrated `textual-speedups` for Rust-based layout primitives, switched the messages container to stream layout, and offloaded blocking path ops from the event loop — noticeably snappier on long conversations.
* **Stability:** 15 bug fixes covering markup injection, scrollbar flicker during streaming, reentrant model switching, and autocomplete race conditions.

### Features

* Client-server architecture via `langgraph dev` ([#1759](https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/1759)) ([f5407e6](https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/commit/f5407e6300e6ee51d8c88f1f183dd960b30a5b56))

changes.description: Agent 工具不再接受 `resume` 参数，需改用 `SendMessage({to: agentId})` 来继续已生成的 agent
HITL 邮件内容现在使用 markdown 渲染，依赖原始/纯文本行为的现有邮件模板升级后可能渲染效果不同
草稿变量从应用级别改为用户级别，升级后历史草稿变量将不可用
废弃 `PUBSUB_*` 事件总线设置，需改用 `EVENT_BUS_*` 设置
废弃 Python 3.9 支持，所有包将不再支持 Python 3.9

issue_insights.summary_brief: 跨仓库共性问题集中在打包发布与初始化（5+仓库）、会话恢复失败（3仓库）、认证/权限传递断裂（4仓库）三类阻断性缺陷，其中打包与初始化问题影响范围最广。单仓高影响问题包括 claude-code 的 API 500 错误（7 例）、AutoGPT 的 BlockUnknownError（4 例），均导致主流程完全中断。
global_highlights: 打包/初始化问题：5+ 仓库存在依赖缺失、发布不完整、初始化崩溃，导致应用完全无法启动（Auto-Claude v2.8.0、claude-agent-sdk-python v0.1.49、claude-code-action、claude-code SDK、opencode desktop）
会话恢复失败：3 仓库的 long-running agent 无法正常恢复，主流程中断（agno Team/Agent Continue、claude-agent-sdk resume、agentscope msghub）
认证/权限传递断裂：4 仓库的工具调用或子代理未继承父级认证/权限配置，导致请求失败（typescript SDK toolRunner、agent SDK bypassPermissions、claude-code-action GHES、OpenDevin token）

source_issues.evidence: Debug configuration uses 'program': '${file}' which attempts to run TypeScript files directly with Node.js. Since Node.js cannot natively execute TypeScript, this causes runtime errors during debugging. User suggests using tsx via npm exec for proper TypeScript execution.

signals.topic: LocalPythonExecutor with statement crashes with threading.Lock

signals.topic: Tool arguments validation fails when LLM returns non-dict JSON values

source_issues.title: UnboundLocalError: resume_is_map when using Command(resume=None)

source_issues.title: Random CancelledError in AsyncPregelLoop cleanup

signals.topic: Checkpoint integrity issues: late writes resurrect deleted threads, unstable ordering
signals.summary: Edge cases affecting checkpoint data integrity in production. Late writes can resurrect deleted data, and timestamp collisions cause non-deterministic behavior. Important for retention/compliance workflows but less common occurrence.
signals.review_reason: Edge cases affecting checkpoint data integrity in production. Late writes can resurrect deleted data, and timestamp collisions cause non-deterministic behavior. Important for retention/compliance workflows but less common occurrence.

source_issues.title: Prevent late checkpoint writes from resurrecting deleted threads
source_issues.evidence: delete_thread removes checkpoint rows but doesn't block late put/put_writes calls. Delayed writer can repopulate state for already-deleted thread, breaking retention and audit workflows.

source_issues.title: checkpoint: add stable tie-breaks for equal timestamp ordering
source_issues.evidence: When two checkpoints share same timestamp, repeated reads can drift by backend because there's no explicit secondary ordering. Breaks deterministic replay/debug across memory, SQLite, Postgres implementations.

signals.topic: Tool error handling breaking change: errors now propagate instead of being handled by default

signals.review_reason: Breaking change in version 1.0.1 that silently changes core behavior. Users upgrading LangGraph find their tool-calling agents crashing where they previously worked, requiring code changes to restore expected behavior.

source_issues.title: [Bug]: Pydantic validation error in AnthropicCompletionResponse
source_issues.evidence: stream_complete triggers ValidationError when chat message contains None as .text - blocks streaming inference with Anthropic models

source_issues.title: [Bug]: ValueError: Cannot use model gpt-5.4-pro as it is only supported by the Responses API
source_issues.evidence: Users cannot use new GPT-5.4-pro model - blocked by hardcoded model validation requiring OpenAIResponses class

source_issues.title: ValueError: Unknown model 'gpt-5.4'
source_issues.evidence: New GPT-5.4 model not recognized - blocks basic inference requests with latest OpenAI models

signals.topic: Structured output parsing silently returns incorrect/empty results
signals.summary: Structured output problems cause silent incorrect results - users get empty/default values without errors, making bugs hard to detect. However, count=2 and single repo, so P2 priority. The silent failure nature makes this impactful for production pipelines.
signals.review_reason: Structured output problems cause silent incorrect results - users get empty/default values without errors, making bugs hard to detect. However, count=2 and single repo, so P2 priority. The silent failure nature makes this impactful for production pipelines.

source_issues.title: [Bug]: `structured_predict()` returns default/empty output for single-field models with LiteLLM
source_issues.evidence: structured_predict silently returns empty/default Pydantic objects when model has single field with default value - especially hard to detect in retrieval pipelines

source_issues.title: [Bug]: `PydanticOutputParser` escapes non-ASCII schema descriptions in formatted prompts
source_issues.evidence: Non-ASCII field descriptions (Chinese, Unicode symbols) escaped as \uXXXX in prompts - degrades readability and reduces model's understanding of field semantics

signals.topic: Doctor diagnostics produce misleading warnings and incorrect detections
signals.summary: Multiple diagnostic failures create confusion and erode trust - users see warnings for correctly configured systems (API keys, MCP server names, config files). Not blocking but leads to wasted troubleshooting time.
signals.review_reason: Multiple diagnostic failures create confusion and erode trust - users see warnings for correctly configured systems (API keys, MCP server names, config files). Not blocking but leads to wasted troubleshooting time.

source_issues.title: doctor: API key warning is misleading when running inside Claude Code
source_issues.evidence: ruflo doctor reports 'No API keys found' warning even when running correctly inside Claude Code which manages auth internally. Misleads users into thinking something is wrong.

source_issues.title: doctor checks for 'claude-flow' MCP server name but .mcp.json uses 'ruflo'
source_issues.evidence: Doctor reports 'MCP Servers: 1 servers (claude-flow not found)' warning when .mcp.json correctly uses 'ruflo' as server name. Should recognize both names for backwards compatibility.

source_issues.title: doctor: config file check doesn't detect .claude-flow/config.yaml
source_issues.evidence: ruflo doctor reports 'No config file (using defaults)' warning even after running 'ruflo config init' which creates .claude-flow/config.yaml. Doctor fails to detect valid config location.

signals.topic: Statusline shows incorrect branding and zeros for vectors/size in fresh installs
signals.summary: New user experience degradation - fresh installs show incorrect branding and missing metrics data. First impression is broken, confusing users about product identity and feature functionality.
signals.review_reason: New user experience degradation - fresh installs show incorrect branding and missing metrics data. First impression is broken, confusing users about product identity and feature functionality.

source_issues.title: fix: statusline shows 'Claude Flow V3' and 'Opus 4.5' instead of 'RuFlo V3.5' and 'Opus 4.6'
source_issues.evidence: Generated statusline shows outdated branding 'Claude Flow V3' instead of 'RuFlo V3.5' and 'Opus 4.5' instead of 'Opus 4.6'. Confuses users about which version is running.

source_issues.title: fix: statusline generator overwrite — vectors/size now work in fresh installs (v3.5.18)
source_issues.evidence: Fresh ruflo init installs showed static zeros for AgentDB vectors, size, tests, hooks. writeStatusline() skipped writing because legacy file already existed from writeHelpers().

signals.topic: Excessive token consumption reaching millions within 30 minutes making Ruflo costly at scale
signals.summary: Open issue with clear user impact: runaway token consumption causes significant cost loss and makes the tool unusable for production workloads. User explicitly states it is 'practically unusable and extremely costly at scale'.
signals.review_reason: Open issue with clear user impact: runaway token consumption causes significant cost loss and makes the tool unusable for production workloads. User explicitly states it is 'practically unusable and extremely costly at scale'.

source_issues.title: Excessive Token Consumption — Thousands to Millions of Tokens Used Within 0–30 Minutes
source_issues.evidence: User reports millions of tokens consumed within 0-30 minutes, making Ruflo practically unusable and extremely costly at scale for production EdTech platform. Token usage spikes occur even for simple tasks.

signals.topic: Hook handler stdin.pause() causes process hang blocking all subsequent chained hooks
signals.summary: Main workflow blocking issue - chained hooks never execute, causing SessionStart to hang indefinitely. Measured impact: before fix hangs forever, after fix completes in 668ms. Direct blocker to normal usage.
signals.review_reason: Main workflow blocking issue - chained hooks never execute, causing SessionStart to hang indefinitely. Measured impact: before fix hangs forever, after fix completes in 668ms. Direct blocker to normal usage.

source_issues.title: bug: hook-handler.cjs stdin.pause() causes process hang when hooks are chained
source_issues.evidence: When Claude Code chains multiple hooks sequentially, the first hook's process never exits due to stdin.pause() keeping fd open, blocking all subsequent hooks indefinitely. SessionStart hangs indefinitely.

signals.topic: Daemon workers don't update metrics and scheduler loop never fires
signals.summary: Core functionality failure - daemon system completely non-functional: scheduler never fires, workers don't persist results. Users cannot get real metrics from their swarms, breaking a key feature for monitoring agent activity.
signals.review_reason: Core functionality failure - daemon system completely non-functional: scheduler never fires, workers don't persist results. Users cannot get real metrics from their swarms, breaking a key feature for monitoring agent activity.

source_issues.title: Daemon workers don't update metric files and scheduler loop doesn't fire
source_issues.evidence: All daemon workers show 0 runs, nextRun timestamps never advance, manually triggered workers succeed but don't write to metric files. Statusline falls back to approximations instead of real metrics.

signals.topic: Multi-byte character (Unicode/UTF-8) handling breaks editor operations
signals.summary: 高频(3个独立issue) + 主流程阻断: 用户在使用非ASCII字符(如umlauts)时，多光标扩展、字符替换、多行选择等核心编辑功能出现明显错误。日志明确显示byte/character边界处理错误。影响Vim/Helix模式和普通编辑模式，是编辑器基础功能问题。
signals.review_reason: 高频(3个独立issue) + 主流程阻断: 用户在使用非ASCII字符(如umlauts)时，多光标扩展、字符替换、多行选择等核心编辑功能出现明显错误。日志明确显示byte/character边界处理错误。影响Vim/Helix模式和普通编辑模式，是编辑器基础功能问题。

source_issues.title: Multi-line cursor expansion does not like umlauts
source_issues.evidence: User reports that multi-cursor expansion (CMD-OPT-down) misaligns cursors when lines contain umlauts. Log shows 'byte index 97 is not a char boundary; it is inside ä' - indicating incorrect byte/character boundary handling. This is a core editor functionality issue affecting non-ASCII text editing.

source_issues.title: Multi-byte characters end up as multiple characters when replaced with vim/helix
source_issues.evidence: When replacing a word containing umlauts (5 chars like 'Hällö') with 'r 1' in vim/helix mode, Zed incorrectly produces 7 ones instead of 5, because multi-byte characters (ä, ö) are counted by bytes instead of characters. This breaks basic editing operations for non-ASCII text.

source_issues.title: helix: multi-line selection doesn't handle multi-byte characters correctly.
source_issues.evidence: In helix mode, multi-line selection expansion with 'C' key incorrectly skips lines or places selection in wrong position when files contain umlauts. This is a related bug to #51740 but affects a different code path (helix-specific).

signals.topic: Terminal keybindings not working correctly (Ctrl/Ctrl-Delete sends wrong sequences)
signals.summary: 2个独立issue + 主流程影响: 终端中Ctrl键和Ctrl-Delete发送错误的转义序列，破坏shell基本功能（命令历史、word killing）。用户明确指出这是回归问题。影响常见的zsh和fish shell用户。
signals.review_reason: 2个独立issue + 主流程影响: 终端中Ctrl键和Ctrl-Delete发送错误的转义序列，破坏shell基本功能（命令历史、word killing）。用户明确指出这是回归问题。影响常见的zsh和fish shell用户。

source_issues.title: Ctrl key bindings do not work in Terminal (zsh)
source_issues.evidence: User reports Ctrl+P in Terminal (zsh) inserts '^P' literally instead of showing previous command history. This breaks essential shell navigation and command history functionality that users expect to work in any terminal.

source_issues.title: ctrl-delete in terminal sends alt-d
source_issues.evidence: Ctrl-Delete incorrectly sends same sequence as Alt-Delete (\u001bd = alt-d), breaking fish shell keybinds where ctrl-delete should be kill-token and alt-delete should be kill-word. User explicitly notes a previous PR was 'a bad change'.

signals.topic: Git panel UI/functionality issues in multi-root workspaces
signals.summary: 2个独立issue + 主流程影响: Git面板在多根工作区或非根目录打开时功能异常。commit message焦点跳转导致意外修改文件，diff面板空白导致无法查看变更。这些是高频使用的Git工作流核心功能。
signals.review_reason: 2个独立issue + 主流程影响: Git面板在多根工作区或非根目录打开时功能异常。commit message焦点跳转导致意外修改文件，diff面板空白导致无法查看变更。这些是高频使用的Git工作流核心功能。

source_issues.title: Theft of UI focus when typing Git commit message
source_issues.evidence: In multi-root workspace with separate Git roots, typing commit message causes focus to jump to buffer editor after ~4 characters, inadvertently modifying that buffer, and commit message disappears to the wrong workspace's Git panel. This disrupts the commit workflow significantly.

source_issues.title: Diff panel doesn't work when you open not a root project folder
source_issues.evidence: When opening a subfolder (not root project folder), the Git diff panel shows empty/blank diffs. This breaks core Git workflow for users who open specific subdirectories of their projects.

signals.topic: Emacs keybindings paste/yank not working
signals.summary: 单条issue但用户影响明确: Emacs模式下的核心剪贴操作(C-y yank)完全失效，插入换行而非粘贴内容。这是基础编辑功能阻断。用户明确提供了复现步骤和临时解决方案证据。
signals.review_reason: 单条issue但用户影响明确: Emacs模式下的核心剪贴操作(C-y yank)完全失效，插入换行而非粘贴内容。这是基础编辑功能阻断。用户明确提供了复现步骤和临时解决方案证据。

source_issues.title: paste/yank not working with emacs keybindings
source_issues.evidence: With Emacs base keymap, C-w (cut) works but C-y (yank/paste) inserts newline instead of pasting cut text. User had to manually rebind C-y to editor::Paste as workaround. The default editor::KillRingYank is broken. Core cut/paste functionality is broken for Emacs users.

signals.topic: File operations fail on FUSE-based filesystems
signals.summary: 单条issue但用户影响明确: 在FUSE文件系统(NTFS, exFAT)上无法重命名文件，产生错误提示，而终端操作正常。这影响使用外置驱动器或双系统设置的用户，是文件管理基础功能阻断。
signals.review_reason: 单条issue但用户影响明确: 在FUSE文件系统(NTFS, exFAT)上无法重命名文件，产生错误提示，而终端操作正常。这影响使用外置驱动器或双系统设置的用户，是文件管理基础功能阻断。

source_issues.title: Renaming files/directories fails on FUSE-based filesystems (NTFS, exFAT)
source_issues.evidence: Renaming files or directories in project panel fails on FUSE-mounted drives (NTFS via ntfs-3g, exFAT) with error toast, while terminal rename works fine. This blocks file management for users working with external drives or dual-boot setups.
